checks.name: product present
checks.detail: product must be a non-empty product id (cover:itch/<slug>, order:<slug>, ...) — next: set brief.product

checks.name: sizes well-formed
checks.detail: sizes must be a non-empty array of {w,h} exact pixels — next: set sizes e.g. [{"w":1280,"h":720,"name":"hero"}]

checks.name: facts source exists
checks.detail: no facts source: declare brief.facts (a path on disk) or brief.order matching orders.csv — next: add "facts": "<listing file>"

checks.name: no forbidden words
checks.detail: no engine names, score claims or personal data in brief strings
